commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -eu
echo '=== USER CRONTAB ==='
crontab -l 2>/dev/null || echo '<none>'
echo
echo '=== SYSTEM CRON REFERENCES ==='
grep -R -n -E 'PhotoMaps|photomap|retain_private|private_original' /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== SYSTEMD TIMERS ==='
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'photo|retain|original' || true
echo
echo '=== SYSTEMD UNIT REFERENCES ==='
systemctl list-unit-files --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'photo|map|cloudflared' || true
echo
echo '=== RELEVANT PROCESSES ==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,etime,args | grep -E '[p]hotomap|[P]hotoMaps|[c]loudflared|[s]erver.py' || true
REMOTE
